about_the_game:
Hidden Heroes is a timed survival game where players progress through increasingly challenging levels, and they can customize the level maps.

Each hero has different skills and attributes. For example, a mage has more skills to use in battle, but fewer available equipment slots. A warrior hero, on the other hand, has more combat equipment but fewer available skill slots.

Many interesting heroes await your unlocking, such as the Mechanic, who places machine gun turrets, the Beastmaster, who summons ferocious giant bears to follow him in battle, and the flamethrowing Red Boy.

There are two battle modes:

Normal mode: A boss appears every 10 minutes, and you defeat it to complete the game.

Endless mode: Battle without a time limit.

In addition to acquiring skills, you can also obtain equipment to enhance your hero's attributes, such as dodge, lifesteal, damage reduction, and over 20 other attributes.

Depending on the difficulty level, you can obtain treasure chests corresponding to the difficulty level. Opening them will grant all-around equipment.

All equipment is color-coded to determine quality, with red being the best.

Gold coins are essential for acquiring new heroes and upgrading their skills.

Enemy attacks in battle each have their own unique mechanics and attack methods.

All characters:

[W] Move up

[A] Move left

[S] Move down

[D] Move right

[Spacebar] Jump

In addition to using buttons to move your hero, you can also use the mouse to move with the virtual joystick.

Some characters:

[Enter] Unleash unique skills

If you like this game, please leave your valuable suggestions and feedback in the comments section.
